chooseResponse.q: What do you think about the new library hours?

conversation.transcript:
Student: Have you seen the new library hours?
Advisor: Yes, they changed to be open 24 hours during finals week.
Student: That sounds really helpful for us!
Advisor: I hope it encourages more students to study when they need to.

questions.q: What are the new hours of the library?
questions.explain: 新圖書館的開放時間是考試週期間全天開放。

questions.q: Why does the advisor think the new hours are beneficial?
options: They allow staff to work longer hours.
They reduce noise in the library.
questions.explain: 顧問認為新的開放時間能鼓勵更多學生學習。

announcement.transcript: Attention students! We are pleased to announce that starting next week, the campus gym will be open 24 hours a day to accommodate all workout schedules. Be sure to check the gym's website for updates on classes and facility availability.

questions.q: When will the gym be open 24 hours?
questions.explain: 健身房將從下週開始全天候開放。

questions.q: Where can students find updates about the gym?
questions.explain: 學生可以在健身房的網站上找到更新資訊。

talk.transcript: Today, I will explain the concept of photosynthesis, which is crucial for life on Earth. Plants, algae, and some bacteria use sunlight to convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen. This process occurs mainly in the chloroplasts of plant cells. The glucose produced is used for energy and growth, while oxygen is released into the atmosphere as a byproduct. Understanding photosynthesis helps us appreciate the role of plants in ecosystems and their importance in the food chain.

questions.q: What is the main product of photosynthesis?
questions.explain: 光合作用的主要產物是葡萄糖。

questions.q: Where does photosynthesis occur in plant cells?
questions.explain: 光合作用在植物細胞的葉綠體中進行。

questions.q: Why is oxygen important in photosynthesis?
options: It is used for energy storage.
questions.explain: 氧氣是光合作用的副產品。

questions.q: What does photosynthesis convert sunlight into?
questions.explain: 光合作用將陽光轉換為葡萄糖。
